verdict.rationale: Convex explicitly ships an open-source, self-hostable backend that runs the same code as the cloud service, with documented compatibility with common infra (Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Postgres, etc.), giving AI-native/open-source users a genuine self-host path. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full self-hosted deployment working end-to-end and details on parity/limitations versus the managed cloud service.
